name: Bestial Spirit (Air)

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The spirit doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee attack: your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 4 + the spell's level Piercing damage.

desc: A spirit summoned by the Summon Beast spell. Numbers shown for a level 2 slot and a +5 spell attack; on the sheet they follow the slot you cast it with.

summon.note: Obeys your verbal commands; acts right after you in Initiative.
